tools.name: search_vacancies
tools.description:
Search active job vacancies on Finder. country: ISO code (ru, by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz; ru = finder.work, Russia).
query: job title / keywords in any language (e.g. 'бухгалтер', 'python developer'). city: city name as written
locally (e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Be

tools.name: get_vacancy
tools.description:
Get details of one vacancy by its Finder id (from search_vacancies). For Russia pass country="ru" (ids from finder.work): title, employer, city, salary,
description (up to 1500 chars) and the finder.work page url where the user can apply.
